en: Gyaaarados! The red Gyarados is thrashing wildly!
The lake has gone still. Something red glints in the water where the Gyarados was.
That was quite a battle. You and your Pokémon handled that Gyarados well.
I'm Lance, a Trainer like you. I've been looking into strange goings-on around this lake.
Magikarp don't turn into raging Gyarados by themselves. Someone is forcing them to evolve, and I mean to find out who.
There's a souvenir shop in Mahogany Town I have my doubts about. Will you help me look into it?
Good. I'll go on ahead. Meet me at the shop in Mahogany Town!
I see. Well, if you change your mind, I'll be right here.
Have you thought it over? Will you help me look into that shop in Mahogany Town?
I see. Well, if you change your mind, I'll be right here.
